summary: Iteration 105: Multi-Store Order Consolidation, Phased Replenishment, Promotion Calendar - All backend (23/23) and frontend tests passed. Fixed route ordering bug where /orders/phased was matched by /orders/{po_number}. Backend: Order consolidation groups plan items by category into POs, PO status workflow (draft→sent→confirmed→shipped→received/cancelled), phased replenishment splits POs into shipments with configurable weeks/percentages (must sum to 100), promotions CRUD with lift_factor validation (0.5-5), active-lift endpoint for buy formula integration. Frontend: Orders tab with Truck icon, orders table with PO number/category/plan/SKUs/units/value/status dropdown/phase button, phase modal with weeks/percentages inputs, Promotions tab with Calendar icon, promotions table with name/type/dates/discount/categories/lift factor/status, Add Promotion modal with all required fields.

TEST_01_list_orders_returns_array.notes: GET /api/buy-planning/orders returns orders array with total count

TEST_02_orders_have_required_fields.notes: Orders have po_number, supplier_group, total_units, total_value, status

TEST_07_po_status_workflow_all_valid_sta.notes: All valid statuses accepted: draft, sent, confirmed, shipped, received, cancelled

TEST_08_list_phased_pos.notes: GET /api/buy-planning/orders/phased returns phased POs (fixed route ordering bug)

TEST_11_phased_po_has_shipments.notes: Phased POs have shipments array with phase, weeks_from_now, percentage, items, total_units, total_value

TEST_14_promotion_has_required_fields.notes: Promotions have name, promo_type, start_date, end_date, lift_factor, affected_categories, status

TEST_18_get_active_lift_factors.notes: GET /api/buy-planning/promotions/active-lift returns active promotions with lift_factor and affected_categories

TEST_F01_orders_tab_visible.notes: Orders tab with Truck icon visible in Buy Planning tabs

TEST_F02_orders_table_visible.notes: data-testid=orders-table present with PO number, category, plan, SKUs, units, value, status, phased columns

TEST_F06_phase_modal_opens.notes: data-testid=phase-modal opens when clicking Phase button

TEST_F08_promotions_tab_visible.notes: Promotions tab with Calendar icon visible

TEST_F09_promotions_table_visible.notes: data-testid=promotions-table shows name, type, dates, discount, categories, lift factor, status

TEST_F11_promo_modal_opens.notes: data-testid=promo-modal opens when clicking Add Promotion

TEST_F12_promo_modal_fields.notes: Modal has promo-name, promo-type, promo-start, promo-end, promo-lift, promo-categories, save-promo-btn

bugs_fixed.issue: Route ordering bug: /orders/phased was matched by /orders/{po_number}

critical_code_review_comments: - POST /api/buy-planning/orders/consolidate: Groups plan items by category into POs with po_number format PO-YYYYMMDD-CATEGORY-NNN
- GET /api/buy-planning/orders: Lists POs with optional plan_id and status filters
- GET /api/buy-planning/orders/{po_number}: Returns single PO with items
- POST /api/buy-planning/orders/phase: Creates phased shipments with configurable weeks and percentages (must sum to 100)
- GET /api/buy-planning/orders/phased: Lists phased POs (route moved before /{po_number} to fix matching)
- POST /api/buy-planning/promotions: Creates promotion with lift_factor validation (0.5-5)
- GET /api/buy-planning/promotions: Lists promotions with optional status filter
- GET /api/buy-planning/promotions/active-lift: Returns active promotions for buy formula integration
- POST /api/buy-planning/buy-formula/calculate applies promo_lift from active promotions matching by category
- Items have promo_lift field (>1 for matching categories)
- Orders table: PO number, category, plan, SKUs, units, value, status dropdown, phase button
- Promotions table: name, type, dates, discount, categories, lift factor, status
- Promo modal (data-testid=promo-modal) with all required fields
seed_data_creation: Existing data from curl testing: 3 POs (Accessories, Apparel, Footwear), 1 phased PO (Accessories-PHASED), 1 promotion (Summer Sale 2026 with lift_factor=1.3 for Apparel). Test promotions created and cleaned up during testing.
